steps.content: You follow Kelvin's gaze and spot a redhead approaching from not far away.
The crowd quiets down for a moment, then erupts like wine being poured into a sizzling steak pan.
They surge forward and surround the woman, trying to chat with her from all sides.

steps.speaker: Guest A
steps.content: Miss Cabernet! What are you planning to do next?

steps.speaker: Guest B
steps.content: I'm thrilled to be spending today with you, Miss Cabernet!

steps.speaker: Guest C
steps.content: Quick, say something to Miss Cabernet! That way, you can put on your resume that you had in-depth exchanges with her at a social event!
The target of all this commotion, Miss Cabernet Franc, faces the surging crowd with elegant poise and a graceful smile...
She doesn't show a hint of impatience on her face.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: I-it's her! It's Miss Cabernet!

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Ah... I never dreamed I'd be able to see Miss Cabernet up close!

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: I've only ever seen her in my courseware and on the news...

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Beautiful... elegant... and with such impeccable knowledge on food...
I brought you back here so you could live well. Father favors beauties like you. You can live happily here, just like I do.
After a while, her voice goes low again, and she just gazes at Cabernet with adoring and expectant eyes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why would someone so popular need to secretly ask the MBCC to retrieve her treasures?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She could make her fans turn this place upside down with a flick of her wrist if she wanted to.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Who wouldn't want to do such a big favor for a famous heiress?
You gaze in perplexity at Cabernet, who is swamped by the crowd.

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: Perhaps... those aren't normal "treasures"?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What?

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: Ah... I just...

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: I know a couple of customers who come from this strata of society. They often use words as euphemisms for something else... a word like "treasure" is probably symbolic.

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: Maybe that's why she wants a government organization that won't leak her secrets to help her?
For some strange reason, it seems as if Cabernet had overheard your conversation from the crowd. She looks over at you from the distance.
She smiles as she gazes at you, and gives you a faint, barely noticeable nod.

steps.speaker: Guest C
steps.content: My family owns a vineyard. The wine there is amazing!

steps.speaker: Guest C
steps.content: Whenever you're free, Miss Cabernet, do drop by to have a taste! I guarantee you'll love it!
Someone suddenly approaches Cabernet and coos at her flatteringly.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Sorry, what did you say...?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Ah yes, about the wine, is it? It would be an honor.

steps.speaker: Guest D
steps.content: Miss Cabernet! Since you're also a guest at the party, does that mean we'll have the honor of hearing your critique of the food here?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I usually don't give reviews on these types of occasions, but I'm willing to share some humble opinions if that's what the host and everyone else wants.

steps.speaker: Guest D
steps.content: Marvelous! I must write down what Miss Cabernet likes. That'll be the hottest dish for the rest of the year...
For a chance to speak to Cabernet, people are throwing all types of topics in the air.
Some flaunt themselves, some give empty boasts, while others coo about how splendid this party has become thanks to Cabernet's presence.
Some are even trying to attract her attention with outlandish actions, such as diving into the pool from great heights and making huge splashes.

steps.speaker: Guest E
steps.content: Look, Miss Cabernet! This is the coolest thing to do at a pool party!

steps.speaker: Guest E
steps.content: Divebomb!!
He barely finished his sentence before tossing his friend into the pool.
After a loud splash, everyone hears his friend cursing from inside the pool.
This makes everyone burst into laughter. Even as they laugh, they don't forget to observe Cabernet from the corner of their eyes.
She's covering her mouth, seemingly giggling in amusement. Upon seeing this, everyone starts to join in on the frenzy.
Regardless one wants to or not.

steps.speaker: Guest F
steps.content: Don't be scared, my friend! The pool's only a meter deep! You won't drown!
steps.female_content: Don't be scared! The pool's only a meter deep! You'll be fine!

steps.speaker: Guest F
steps.content: Hey bro! Don't you want to take a dip?! The water's quite refreshing!
steps.female_content: Hey sis, don't you want to take a dip?! The water feels quite comfy!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We don't want to join, stay back please...

steps.speaker: Guest F
steps.content: Come on, you're here already! Who comes to a party and doesn't want to have fun?
You continue to refuse, but someone grabs your ankle and pulls you into the pool!
steps.female_content: You continue to refuse, but someone grabs your wrist and pulls you into the pool!
